descricao.en: A record label dedicated to sonic and visual experimentation. A collective space where different projects, identities, and sounds coexist. From heavy and distorted riffs to cold, ethereal synthscapes. Each project carries its own voice, its own narrative, and its own visual identity. An ongoing archive of experiments, a space where boundaries are tested and the only commitment is to the art of sound.

Built on heavy, mechanical drum machines, distorted synths, and abrasive textures, the project creates an oppressive and claustrophobic atmosphere. The vocals are purely screamed, distorted, and aggressive, with no room for clean vocals or melody. It is the sound of pure mechanical fury, where every track is a relentless assault of noise and aggression.

descricao.en: Dark science fiction universe where sound and narrative merge to create an immersive, fictional world. Every release, whether music, visual, or story, is a fragment of a larger interconnected mythos. Transmissions from the void. The signal never stops.

A gothic ritualistic project born from the shadows of a dark universe. The embodiment of the supernatural and the occult. The lyrics speak of the invisible, the night, the blood, the moon, the altar, and the rite. Darkness is not an escape; it is a consecration. The music is not just dark; it is ceremonial. The narrative is driven by figures who witness and participate in the supernatural, wielding the powers claimed during rituals. The sound blends gothic weight with symphonic ambition, merging heavy melancholy with orchestral grandeur. It is female-fronted, with ethereal, whispered vocals that grow into powerful choruses, always maintaining a cinematic, ritualistic, and deeply gothic atmosphere.

The beginning of the ritual. Under the blood moon, an ancient and nameless force is invoked, creating a duality between power and fear. It captures the calm before the storm, the omen in the sky, the consecration of the altar, and the devastating destruction that follows when the summoned power refuses to obey.
A consecration in the dark. The heavy, sacred atmosphere of a forgotten sanctuary where time seems to have stopped, and the air itself feels like a held breath.

descricao.en: The price of the ritual. The invocation drags the priestess into the abyss. The grace she once touched decays into ash. The storm tears the sky apart, and she discovers she cannot control what she has awakened. The throne she thought she built is nothing but ruin.

The aftermath. The silence after the fall. What remains of her wanders through the ruins. There is no more fury, only cold, ice, and empty dawns. Ethereal presences walk among the shadows, carrying the wounds of a crown that never truly existed.

The immortality. When the aftermath ends, something remains. The hunger awakens. The blood calls. The nights become eternal. She walks through the centuries, watching empires fall, watching the world change, while she remains unchanged. Immortality is not a gift; it is a sentence, served one night at a time.

A brilliant hacker living in a world that was soon reduced to ashes. Discovered by the enemy and left to die with 80% of his body burned by the fire. Rescued and rebuilt with metal and wires by his best friend, he became a cyborg, half man, half machine. What remains is not just a survivor, but a man forged by tragedy, carrying the weight of a war that took everything from him. The sound is pure, raw heavy metal, thrash metal, and doom metal. It is built on pounding drums, heavily distorted guitars, and a powerful, gritty male vocal that shifts between three distinct registers: angry, aggressive screams; fragile, high-pitched wails of pain; and a classic thrash metal delivery. It is the sound of the fire that forged the man.
A short and powerful breath of resilience. Pure defiance against the ashes. The proof that even after the fire and the dark, the spark remains unquenched.

descricao.en: The cold revenge of hacking into the enemy's systems. The shock of the fire. The pain of being reconstructed piece by piece. The obsession with a machine that could change everything. The abandonment. And finally, the acceptance of a legacy born from ashes. A chronicle of destruction and survival.

The memory of a life before the war. The peace, the routine, and the quiet love shared in a world that was soon to be lost. It is the story of a world worth saving, and the creeping shadow that consumed it all.

The ruins of a love destroyed by forces beyond control. It narrates the heavy silence, the words left unsaid, and the impossibility of repairing what was broken. It is the agonizing choice of letting go of what mattered most.
A violent clash born from blind rage and a moment of regret. It traces the fragile journey from bitter rivalry to mutual respect, forging an unbreakable alliance against the coming storm.
The darkest chapter. The despair of being the last one standing. The loss of hope. And the final, desperate stand against the colonizer.

The crushing weight of a truth that cannot be unlearned. The suffocating guilt of every life touched, the shadow of every tragedy. It is the moment when the creator must face the absolute silence of his own making.

A fugitive running from a reality that has cracked open. She saw the grid behind the world, the numbers that hold the real, and now she cannot stop running. She does not know who built it or if there is an outside. She only knows that the system adapts, and the relentless hunters are always behind her. Her mind is fractured enough to see the cracks, but is it a revelation or a hallucination? The system knows her name, and the only way out is forward. The sound is defined by modern drum and bass, liquidfunk, and neurofunk. Heavy Reese basslines, machine-gun drum patterns, and glitch effects act as narrative elements. Her vocals are ethereal and fragmented, acting as a texture rather than a message, blending the adrenaline of a chase with the cold paranoia of a digital nightmare.

The adrenaline of the break. The relentless pursuit of the agents. The exhaustion of running without rest, and the desperate search for a glitch in the system. It is the pure instinct of survival when the only way out is forward, straight into the unknown.
The first step into the neon void. Breaking the system and running faster than the light.

The aftermath of a failed escape. The system resets, leaving no trace of the damage. But a temporary breach opens, revealing a glimpse of what lies beyond the code. There is nothing left to do but keep running, carrying the only thing that matters: the question of what exists past the edge.

The embodiment of grief and unfulfilled love. An existence confined entirely within the confines of its own mind, mourning a loss that is as absolute as it is silent. The sonic identity blends gothic, darkwave, and post-punk with an ethereal, fragile female vocal, drenched in reverb and heavy with despair. It is the sound of the void left behind when someone leaves, a presence that lives entirely in the past because the present is too painful to inhabit.

A hymn to the unattainable. Not the pain of a breakup, but the agonizing devotion to someone who will never be yours. It explores the beauty found in ruin and the terrible preservation of a love that never existed.

The discovery of a truth that was never meant to be found. An account of something impossible, buried in the dust of a dead world. It is the crushing weight of knowing, and the quiet tragedy of being ignored by those who refused to listen. A legacy left behind for a future that may never come.

The silence in a world that screams. Living in a dystopian, colonized urban center, she represents the psychological erosion caused by an oppressive regime. While the world reacts with anger, this is the slow, agonizing dissolution of identity. Suffering from memory loss and depersonalization, it is someone standing at their own front door, holding a key that no longer fits, wondering if they ever belonged there at all. Fragmented memories of a past that might not be real. The terrifying void of recognizing familiar faces but feeling nothing. It culminates in front of a mirror that reflects nothing but the initial shock of losing oneself.

descricao.en: An act of emotional archaeology. A return to the places of grief, not to mourn, but to see what remains. It is the acceptance of the scars, the transformation of pain into something it can endure, and the quiet courage to close the gate and walk forward.

The ancestral witness, a presence that existed before time was measured. Represented by the sound of ancient instruments, the Nay flute, the Mizmar, and the Arghul, this is not a person, but a voice from the desert. The music is the sound of empires rising and falling, of blood soaking into the earth, and of the eternal cycle of creation and ruin. It is the memory of the ground itself, singing the history of civilizations that have turned to dust. Bridging the ancient and the futuristic, it blends organic deep house and ethnic electronic with traditional Middle Eastern melodies. It is the sound of the desert: vast, patient, and indifferent to the passage of time. It does not fight; it simply outlasts, watching as thrones are buried beneath the dunes.

A complete cycle of an empire. It tells the story of a civilization forged from the black mud and the sweat of the workers, rising to monuments of power and cosmic transcendence, before the inevitable sands swallow everything. It is a story of how everything that rises is destined to fall into dust.
Before the first stone, there was the river. The black soil. The sound of water that built an empire, and watched it turn to dust.

descricao.en: A testament to the human attempt to defy time. It is the sound of temples burning with light, of hands lifting stones to hold up the sky, and the promise of permanence. The desert is still there, but amidst the stone, a green garden blooms, representing the fragile but stubborn persistence of life.

The sound of war. It deals with the destruction of the scorched earth, the lament for the fallen, and the red scars left behind. Victory is not celebrated here; only the heavy, bloody price of conflict is remembered.

The silence after the war. The rain washes the blood from the sand, and the fire leaves only ash. But from the blackened earth, a single stem rises. A story about the cold emptiness of the aftermath and the quiet resilience of life starting over in the white, empty desert.

Looking up. No walls, no chains, no end. The sky opens up, and the desert ceases to be a prison, becoming a door instead. The vastness of the blue horizon awaits, carrying the acceptance of scars that now shine like stars. The journey doesn't end; it just changes shape.

The golden end. The sun sets on the empire and the story. The desert has given everything, and now it rests under a silent, golden sky. The horizon waits, carrying the echoes of every journey that came before.
Before the first stone, there was the river. The black soil. The sound of water that built an empire, and watched it turn to dust.

descricao.en: The time traveler who never wins. Originally just a man who believed in his best friend, he was forced into a temporal loop when he piloted a time machine to prevent the invasion. Trapped in a cycle where every failure resets the day and throws him into a different era or planet, he is the ultimate tragic hero. He knows the name of everyone who will die, he knows the exact second the bombs will fall, yet he never stops trying. He is the anchor of the universe, the thread that connects the timelines, even if he is doomed to always arrive too late. The sound is defined by dark synthwave, outrun, and retrowave. Cold, nocturnal, and cinematic, it features pulsating basslines and melancholic synths. The vocal delivery is robotic, tired, and spoken more than sung, reflecting a man who has repeated the same words a thousand times in the dark.

The beginning, before the war and the machine. The pure friendship forged long before the ashes. It covers the tragedy of the attack, the fire that consumed a friend, and the agonizing decision to leave them behind to step into the unknown. It is the origin of the guilt that will fuel an eternal cycle.

This reign is eternal
This reign is eternal
We never fall
We never fade
Eternal reign
Eternal reign

Forever
Forever
Eternal

descricao.en: The terror seen from below. The agony of those who watched their world disappear. The panic of the first contact and the slow realization that the future has been erased.

The exact moment the world changes forever. A silent presence descending from above, so unknown that it defies comprehension. The terrifying realization that it does not need to speak to deliver a sentence.

lyrics.en:
Something appeared
Where the sky used to be
No one could name it
No one could look away

A sound without source
A light without warmth
The air became heavy
The silence became loud

What comes now
What follows the stillness
No one knows

The streets emptied slowly
Doors locked from inside
Something was waiting
Something was watching

What comes now
What follows the stillness
No one knows

It did not speak
It did not need to

descricao.en: The claustrophobia of a perfect trap. The slow realization that every exit is an illusion, and that the only destination left is the point from which there is no return.

lyrics.en:
They ran to the eastern gate
The eastern gate was closed
They ran to the western wall
The western wall had fallen

A voice in the crowd screamed run
But no one knew which way
A child asked where the sky had gone
No one could answer

No way out
No way out
No way out
No way out

The tunnels filled with smoke
The bridges burned ahead
Every path led back to the center
And the center was already taken

No way out
No way out
No way out
No way out

The ground beneath was not safe
The air above was not ours

descricao.en: The complete collapse of empathy. A reality where survival demands the abandonment of everything that made them human. The terrifying realization that cruelty is just a matter of circumstance.

lyrics.en:
They took the old man first
Dragged him across the square
No one moved to stop them
No one dared to stare

A neighbor turned against a neighbor
For a ration and a name
The strong began to feed on the weak
And called it staying alive

This is how it looks from below
The weight of the boot
The silence of the fallen
The shame of the ones who watched

The children learned to steal
The mothers learned to hide
The fathers learned that courage
Was the fastest way to die

This is how it looks from below
The weight of the boot
The silence of the fallen
The shame of the ones who watched

Mercy was a word
That belonged to another world

descricao.en: The illusion of assimilation. A desperate attempt to belong, only to realize that acceptance is a door that remains permanently locked. The pain of seeming like a stranger in the place you were used to calling home.

lyrics.en:
Learned their language
Wore their clothes
Stood in their lines
Answered their calls

They looked at me
And saw the place I came from
They heard my voice
And heard the world I lost

I will never be one of them
No matter how close I stand
I will never be one of them
The gate is always closed

Gave them my name
They gave me a number
Showed them my hands
They showed me the door

I will never be one of them
No matter how close I stand
I will never be one of them
The gate is always closed

The door does not open
It never did

descricao.en: The erasure of tomorrow. A reality where time has lost its meaning, and the future is no longer a promise, but a sentence. The silence of a generation that has nothing left to pass on.

lyrics.en:
The sun does not rise
It only pretends
A pale imitation
Of what we once had

No one speaks of tomorrow
No one names a child
The calendar is empty
The clock is standing still

There is no future here
Only the weight of now
There is no future here
Only the fading light

Once there was a season
When hope was not a wound
Once there was a reason
To lift our eyes from the ground

There is no future here
Only the weight of now
There is no future here
Only the fading light

We stopped asking
Long ago

descricao.en: The final erasure. A void where an entire civilization used to breathe, leaving no monuments, no memories, and no echoes behind. The absolute triumph of silence over existence.

lyrics.en:
Something was here
Now the silence
Something was here
Now the silence

Something was here
Now the silence
Something was here
Now the silence

Something was here
Now the silence
Something was here
Now the silence

descricao.en: The cold face of power. The resistance is dead. There is no need for violence or shouting anymore; the control is silent, calculated, and absolute. It is the reality of a regime that has won, where obedience is no longer a choice, but a program. Colder, quieter, and far more terrifying than the chaos of war.
A funeral procession for a voice that has already been silenced. The heavy, suffocating quiet of a world holding its breath, waiting for the final blow to fall.

lyrics.en: [Instrumental]

descricao.en: The terrifying quiet of a system that has already won. Control is no longer maintained through violence or fear, but through the absolute, inescapable architecture of the new reality.

lyrics.en:
There is no opposition now
There is no voice but mine
The air moves when I allow it
The silence speaks when I permit

You do not resist because you forgot how
You do not speak because you forgot your name
This is not cruelty
This is order

I govern
Not by force
I govern
By design

There is no opposition now

descricao.en: The terrifying realization that nothing is accidental. The streets, the rules, the fear, all of it is a calculated blueprint. A perfect cage disguised as a city.

lyrics.en:
Every wall was placed with purpose
Every silence was engineered
The streets you walk were drawn by me
The air you breathe was allocated

You think you chose this life
You think you made a home
But the home was built before you
And the choice was never yours

This is not chaos
This is by design
Every door that closes
Was drawn before your time

By design
By design

descricao.en: The ultimate triumph of control. A state where rebellion is not crushed, but forgotten. The horror of a body moving in perfect synchronization, acting without the need for commands.

lyrics.en:
I do not need to be told
My hands already know
The position of surrender
The angle of the bow

There is no thought of resistance
The thought itself was removed
What you call obedience
Is just the absence of refusal

Compliant
Before the order comes
Compliant
The will was gone before the will was mine

I do not need to be told
I do not need to be told

descricao.en: A world stripped of all noise, except for the heavy breathing of terror. It is not harmony, but the absolute submission of a population that no longer dares to make a sound.

lyrics.en:
The streets are silent now
No one dares to speak
The noise you used to make
Is buried with the weak

This is not peace
This is the quiet of the grave
The only sound permitted
Is the sound of being saved

This is the new quiet
The silence of the ruled
This is the new quiet
The loudest sound is fear

The new quiet
The new quiet

descricao.en: The ultimate lie of absolute power. A doctrine that perverts the meaning of peace, convincing the broken that their chains are a form of salvation and that true freedom is found only in total submission.

lyrics.en:
The ones who fought are silent now
The ones who questioned are erased
The only path that remains
Is the path of least resistance

They call it peace because the war is over
They call it peace because no one is left to fight
The graves are shallow but the silence is deep
And deep is where the truth will sleep

Obedience is peace
Surrender is salvation
Obedience is peace
The only freedom is compliance

Obedience is peace
Obedience is peace

descricao.en: The final, terrifying monument. A power so absolute that resistance has become a forgotten myth. There is no challenger, no rebel, and no fall, only the endless, silent permanence of the conqueror.

lyrics.en:
There is no throne above this throne
There is no voice beyond this voice
The universe has bowed
And the bowing never ends

I have outlasted every rebellion
I have silenced every prayer
What remains is not a kingdom
What remains is a monument to fear

Unchallenged
Forever and ever
Unchallenged
The crown does not fall

Unchallenged
Unchallenged

descricao.en: The sound of extermination, without negotiation, only elimination. It is the raw violence of a species being wiped out, ending with the terrifying silence of a world where no one is left.

The slow, agonizing aftermath. The sound of survival when there is nothing left to live for. It explores the chronic pain, the exhaustion of grief, and the terrifying realization that the pain has become the only thing keeping you alive.
The horror of two distinct consciousnesses blending into a single, terrifying harmony of hatred and surrender.
The total annihilation of a world, discarded and broken. It is the silence that follows the end, where nothing remains but debris and the cold void left behind by a departing force.
The slow, empty pace of a journey through the void to the next world. It is cold, empty, and inevitable. The silence of the search, terminated by finding the next target.
